verdict.rationale: Docs show server-side session creation via API (type=document, id_number), a hosted/conversion-optimized verification flow with document+selfie matching, redirect/embed integration options, webhook-based result notification, and programmatic access to results/images — matching the full story. Community feedback corroborates the hosted flow's ease of use and cross-device capture without custom UI. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party mention of a drop-in/embeddable JS component (vs. hosted redirect) and some hands-on reports of document-type edge-case failures (e.g., certain passports) that slightly temper reliability confidence.
